outcome: Obesity prevalence at 7 years of age
cohort: The study included 460,363 children (51% boys) from Danish population-based registries between 2001 and 2018, all of whom had an anthropometric assessment at age 7 years.
finding: Prenatal and early-life exposure to anti-infectives significantly increases the risk of childhood obesity at age 7, with the magnitude of association varying by anti-infective type, timing, and dose.
